card.name: UK phone codes and English place settings
card.fires_on: The closing bracket or number in UK phone codes like (44) or (0)1904, and small words or 'UK' just before English place names in British settings.

modes.label: UK phone codes
modes.description: The bracket after 44 or 0 in a British telephone number.

modes.label: Before English places
modes.description: A small word such as to, in or for, or 'UK', right before an English town or county in a British biography or heritage text.
modes.example: moved<< to>> Alfoxton House, Somerset, just

card.plain: It fires in UK phone numbers and just before English place names, where the text is already clearly British.
